entry.title: US universities race to launch AI majors as the count passes 100, nearly double in a year
entry.summary:
Amanyuvesi angaphezu kuka-100 aseMelika manje asenikeza iziqu zeBachelor kubuhlakani bokwenziwa phakathi kwemisebenzi yesayensi yamakhompiyutha, okuyinani eliphindwe kabili onyakeni owodwa, ngokusho kwesizindalwazi esigcinwa yiCentre for Inclusive Computing yaseNyuvesi yaseNortheastern. Iziqu ze-AI zaseNyuvesi yaseBentley zikhule kusukela kubafundi abambalwa lapho ziqalwa ngo-2024 ziyoba cishe ngu-100 kulonyaka, kuyilapho iziqu zeMIT zeAI and Decision Making, eziqalwa ngo-2022, ezimanje zingeziqu zesibili ezithandwa kakhulu enyuvesi, nabafundi abangu-354 ababhalisile. Abaphathi bathi lokhu kushesha kuphathelene nokukhathazeka kwabafundi ngemakethe yemisebenzi eguqulwe yi-AI kanye nesidingo sabaqashi sabaqeqeshwe ku-AI; ucwaningo lwaNhlaba luthole ukuthi okuphezu nencane kwesigamu sezikhungo ezingu-66 ezihloziwe ezinikeza iziqu ze-AI zidinga isifundo sokuziphatha.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngomsebenzi weWits AHEAD we-AI, amandla abathweswe iziqu, ukuqashwa nokuguquka olunobulungiswa, isilinganiso nesivinini sakhona lokuguquka eNyakatho Yomhlaba, kanye nesidingo esingafani sokuqeqeshwa kwezimiso zokuziphatha esihambisana nalo, kungesinye isibonelo iWits AHEAD engasisebenzisa ukucabanga indlela amanyuvesi aseAfrika angakwenza iziqu ze-AI ezifanele ngendlela yesibopho kunokuba ngokuphendula nje.

WBUR · Public radio news report

entry.title: Study combines AI-TPACK and Freire's critical pedagogy to rethink AI in African STEM curricula
entry.summary:
Abacwaningi ababili baseNyuvesi yaseNingizimu Afrika (UNISA) bahlinzeka ngohlaka lombono wokufaka ubuhlakani bokwenziwa (i-AI) ezinhlelweni zokufunda ze-STEM kulo lonke iAfrika, behlanganisa imodeli ye-AI-TPACK nefilosofi yokufundisa engokuhlaziya kaPaulo Freire. Ngokusekela ekubukeni kabanzi kwezincwadi kunokwenza ucwaningo olusha emabalazweni, iphepha lihlola amathuluzi afana nezinhlelo zokuqondisa ezihlakaniphile, amapulatifomu okufunda okuzivumelanisayo nokuhlolwa okuzenzakalelayo, liphakamisa ukuthi lawa angasiza ukwehlisa ingcindezi emakilasini agcwele futhi anezinsizakusebenza ezilinganiselwe. Liphakamisa amasu avumelana nesiko futhi asekelwe ezimisweni zokuziphatha, abhekana nezikhala zengqalasizinda, amandla othisha nokuhlukahluka kwezimo, ukuze ukwamukelwa kwe-AI kungakhulisi ukungalingani okukhona.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngomsebenzi weWits AHEAD mayelana ne-AI nokuhlaziya kwedatha ku-STEM nemfundo yothisha, leli phepha linikeza uhlaka oluphawulayo, olusekelwe eAfrika, lokulinganisa izithembiso ze-AI ekufundiseni i-STEM ngokumelene nezivimbelo zangempela zengqalasizinda kanye namandla othisha, okungaba isixwayiso esifanele sihlale sikhona ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho kushesheliswa ukwamukelwa kwe-AI.

Eurasia Journal of Mathematics, Science and Technology Education (University of South Africa) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Survey finds most Built Environment students use AI chatbots but African universities still lack formal AI policy
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo lwabafundi be-Built Environment, olwethulwa eMhlanganweni we-FIG wango-2026 eKapa, luthole ukuthi amaphesenti angu-74 asebenzisa izinkulumo-mpendulo ze-AI ngokwemfundo, futhi anemibono eminingi emihle ngazo, kodwa libika ukuthi kukhona ukuqondiswa okuncane kwezikhungo. Ababhali, ababhala besezweni laseNamibia nelaseNigeria, baphawula ukuthi amanyuvesi ambalwa kuphela aseNingizimu Afrika, kuhlanganise iWits, iNyuvesi yaseKapa, iNyuvesi yasePitoli neNyuvesi yaseJohannesburg, enze izinqubomgomo ze-AI kusukela ngo-2024, kukhona amaphesenti angaphansi nje kwa-70 amanyuvesi aseMelika aseneminqubomgomo ye-AI ebhaliwe. Baphakamisa uhlaka lwenqubo lwamanyuvesi aseAfrika ukuba akhe izinqubomgomo zokulawula i-AI ezihambisana nezimo zawo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngensika yeWits AHEAD ye-AI enokuzibophezela, imithetho yokuziphatha, ukulingana nenqubomgomo, ukutholakala kokuthi iningi lezikhungo zaseAfrika zisengenayo inqubomgomo ye-AI esheshayo, nakuba abafundi basebenzisa izinkulumo-mpendulo ze-AI ngokubanzi, kukhombisa indlela ukuphathwa okusalele emuva kokwenzeka; uhlaka lweliphepha lunikeza isizinda sokuqala sokuvala leli gebe.

FIG Congress 2026 (International Federation of Surveyors), Cape Town · Conference paper (International Federation of Surveyors)

entry.title: WISE and Education Collaborative partner with five African universities on an AI adoption pilot
entry.summary:
I-WISE (i-World Innovation Summit for Education) ne-Education Collaborative yase-Ashesi University baqalise uhlelo lokuhlolwa lokusetshenziswa kwe-AI namanyuvesi amahlanu ase-Afrika: i-Bells University of Technology eNigeria, i-Botho University eBotswana, i-KCA University eKenya, i-University of Kigali eRwanda kanye ne-Université d'Abomey-Calavi eBenin. Kusukela ngoMfumfu 2026 kuya kuNhlangulana 2027, inyuvesi ngayinye izohlola iphrojekthi efanele izinto eziyigqugquzela, kusukela kubafundisi be-AI abahambisana nekharikhulumu nezinsiza zokufunda ezivumelana nezidingo, kuya ezinhlelweni zokuxwayisa kusenesikhathi nemithombo yokubusa yesikhungo. Lolu hlelo lususelwa kucwaningo lwesisekelo lwango-2025 olwahlola amanyuvesi angu-47 ase-Afrika, olwathola ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI akuhlangene kahle futhi ukubusa kusesebuthakathaka.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Emsebenzini ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana nokubusa kwe-AI ngokunembeza, lolu kuhlolwa kwamazwe amaningi okuyingqayizivele kuhlola ngasikhathi sinye amathuluzi e-AI kanye nezinqubomgomo zesikhungo emanyuvesini amahlanu ase-Afrika ahluke kakhulu, okunikeza ubufakazi bokuqala bokuqhathanisa bokuthi ukusetshenziswa okunembeza kubukeka kanjani ngempela.

africa.com (WISE and The Education Collaborative, Ashesi University) · International education initiative announcement

entry.title: Early success indicators at a South African university: a data-centric approach to student success
entry.summary:
Ongu Philokuhle Majozi noKgadi Mathabathe base-University of Pretoria baphakamise uhlaka olubizwa ngokuthi "izibonakaliso zempumelelo zokuqala," oluhlanganisa idatha nezinyathelo zokusekela kuwo wonke umjikelezo wempilo yomfundi, kusukela ngaphambi kokubhalisa kuze kuyokufika ekuhlolweni kokugcina. Ngokususelwa ezinhlolovweni nabaqeqeshi bempumelelo yezifundo, abaphathi bezikhungo kanye nosayensi bedatha, uhlaka luncamela indlela egxile emandleni nesebenza ngaphambili, kunokugxila kwamasistimu wokuxwayisa kusenesikhathi agxile ebuthakathakeni ababiza ngokuthi "basengcupheni."

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Lokhu kunikeza insika ka-Wits AHEAD yokuhlaziywa kwedatha okubikezelayo isimo esivela eNingizimu Afrika nesigxile emandleni njengenqwaba efanele kunamamodeli avamile okuxwayisa kusenesikhathi, okusiza ngqo ekwakhiweni kwezinyathelo zokugcinwa kwabafundi ezisekela kunokuthi zivele ziphawule abafundi ababhekana nobunzima.

Journal of Student Affairs in Africa · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Cambridge-led OpRaise report: AI markers favour style over substance in university essays
entry.summary:
Abacwaningi bamanyuvesi e-Cambridge, i-Manchester Metropolitan ne-Nottingham bahlole amamodeli amathathu aphambili e-AI, ngayinye nangokuhlanganiswa, ku-essay 761 abafundi be-psychology e-undergraduate avela emanyuvesi amathathu e-UK. Amamodeli avumelana kakhulu phakathi kwawo, kodwa kancane nabahloli abangabantu, ehlala enika amamaki aphezulu umbhalo omude futhi oyinkimbinkimbi ngaphandle kokubheka izinga lokufunda, futhi amamaki abuthaniswa ophakathini kwesikali.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Njengoba i-Wits AHEAD icabangela indima ye-AI ekuhloleni, lobu bufakazi obuqinile, obuvela ezikhungweni ezahlukene, bukhombisa ukuthi ukumaka ngokuzenzakalela kusalokhu kugqugquzela indlela yokubhala kunokuqukethwe, okuyisixwayiso ngokuthi ungasebenzisi i-AI esikhundleni sokwahlulela komuntu emanyuvesi aseNingizimu yomhlaba, lapho amakilasi makhulu kakhulu futhi abahloli bambalwa.

University of Cambridge, Manchester Metropolitan University and the University of Nottingham (OpRaise project) · University research report

entry.title: World Bank video: Korea Partnership Facility forum explores AI for education and skills
entry.summary:
Isiteshi se-YouTube seWorld Bank Group sikhiphe ividiyo emfushane ngomhlangano wonyaka wezi-2026 we-Korea-World Bank Group Partnership Facility, lapho izikhulu zoMnyango wezoMnotho nezeZimali waseKorea, ochwepheshe be-World Bank kanye noSolwazi wase-KAIST baxoxa ngokuthi i-AI ingakwazi kanjani ukuqinisa ukufunda futhi ilungiselele abantu imisebenzi yangomuso. Le Facility ixhasa izinhlelo ze-AI nezamakhono edijithali emibusweni yezemfundo nemisebenzi emazweni asathuthuka.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ku-Pillar 4, lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi amabhange ezezimali emhlabeni manje asebuka ukuqeqeshwa kwamakhono e-AI njengokubalulekile ekuqashekeni kwabathweswe iziqu nokuguquka okunobulungiswa, hhayi njengokuthe ongezelelwe.

World Bank Group (YouTube) · International financial institution, official video channel

entry.title: Study finds South African universities' AI policies strong on student rules, thin on privacy and staff duties
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo olubheka izinqubomgomo ze-AI ekhiqizayo ezishicilelwe amanyuvesi kahulumeni aseNingizimu Afrika luthola ukuthi ngesikhathi socwaningo, amanyuvesi angu-46 ekhulwini kuphela abe enenqubomgomo yesikhungo sonke. Lapho izinqubomgomo zikhona, zibeka imithetho ecacile mayelana nokucaciswa nokuphendulela kwabafundi, kodwa zibhekana nobumfihlo, ukuphathwa kwedatha nokuphendulela kwabasebenzi ngomfutho oncane, ikakhulukazi njengeseluleko hhayi njengemithetho ebophezelayo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ku-Pillar 6, lobu bufakazi ngqo be-Wits AHEAD: ababhali bafuna izinqubomgomo zokuvumelana, ezakhelwe ukuvikela ubumfihlo kusukela ekuqaleni, okungukhona kuyinqo yokuphatha i-AI ngendlela enesibopho leli qembu elihlala lilandela.

Universal Access in the Information Society · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Smartphone AI tools help STEM teachers in low-resource African classrooms move beyond chalk and talk, study finds
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo olulandelayo oluholwa yiNyuvesi yesayensi yaseMalaysia (Universiti Sains Malaysia) lusebenzisane nothisha beSTEM abayishumi baseNigeria, Botswana, Ghana, Namibia naseSierra Leone ekhuphukeni okusebenzayo lapho kusetshenziswa amathuluzi e-AI okuguqula izwi libe yisithombe, ukuhlela ngamabhulokhi kusho ucingo lwesandla kanye nokulingisa izinhlelo zombani. Othisha bathi la mathuluzi enza izingqinamba zemfundiso yesayensi zibe lula ukubonisa, avumela abafundi abangenawo amakhompyutha asendleleni ukuthi bakhe amakhono okuhlela esicingweni, futhi abavumela ukuhlola izinhlelo zombani ngokuphepha ngaphambi kokuthinta izinsiza zangempela ezincane.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ku-Pillar 3, lobu bufakazi obuhle bokuthi amathuluzi e-AI akhethwe ngokucophelela futhi angabizi, hhayi izinsiza zamakhompyutha ezibiza kakhulu, yiwo angaguqula ukufundiswa kweSTEM emakilasini aseAfrika angenazo izinsiza ukusuka ekufundiseni kwenziwa ngesikhathi kuya ekuphenyeni kwangempela.

ECNU Review of Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Africa must build its own AI and data, not just adopt it, UFS tells QS Africa Forum
entry.summary:
Emhlanganweni we-QS Africa Forum 2026 e-Addis Ababa, uSolwazi Sam Tshehla, iPhini likaShansela e-University of the Free State (UFS), wathi engxoxweni mayelana nesidingo se-AI nekusasa lemfundo ephakeme ukuthi amanyuvesi ase-Afrika kumele ayeke ukusabela kuphela kwe-AI futhi akhe i-data namasistimu akhe awodwa akhombisa izilimi, amasiko kanye nezinto ezibalulekile zokuthuthuka zalo mzabalazo. Wathi i-AI ingasiza kuwo wonke uhambo lomfundi, kusukela ekwamukeleni kuya ekufundisweni nocwaningo, kodwa kuphela uma kukhona ukutshalwa kwezimali ekufundiseni ngobuchwepheshe bedijithali, ukuphathwa kanye nemigomo yokuziphatha.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Emsebenzini wePillar 6 mayelana ne-AI enokuzibophezela, imigomo yokuziphatha, ukulingana kanye nenqubomgomo, lesi sibizo sedatha namasistimu okungewe-Afrika sivumelana nokugcizelela kwa-Wits AHEAD kwemibono yokuphatha i-AI egxile endaweni, kunokungenisa kwamanye amazwe, emazweni aseNingizimu Yomhlaba.

University of the Free State · University report

entry.title: AI exposure linked to 13 percentage point rise in top grades, Berkeley working paper finds
entry.summary:
Iphepha lokusebenza elibhalwe ngu-Igor Chirikov we-Center for Studies in Higher Education e-University of California, Berkeley, lihlaziya amamaki angaphezu kuka-500,000 anikezwa phakathi kuka-2018 no-2025 enyuvesi enkulu yocwaningo. Ezifundweni ezinemisebenzi eminingi yokubhala nokubhala ikhodi, ingxenye yamamaki aphezulu enyuke ngama-phesenti ayi-13 ngemva kokukhishwa kwe-ChatGPT, cishe amaphesenti ayi-30 ngaphezu kwesisekelo sango-2022, nokwenyuka okukhulu kwenzeka lapho umsebenzi wasekhaya ubalwa kakhulu emakini okugcina.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Emsebenzini wePillar 1 mayelana ne-AI ekhiqizayo ekufundiseni, ekuhlolweni nasekuthembekeni, lolu cwaningo luyisexwayiso sokuthi amamaki aphezulu akusho ukufunda okungcono: umsebenzi ka-Wits AHEAD wokubuyekeza ukuhlolwa kudinga ubheke leli ngozi efanayo emisebenzini yasekhaya.

Center for Studies in Higher Education, UC Berkeley · Working paper, University of California, Berkeley (CSHE)

entry.title: Generative AI closes three-quarters of the productivity gap between more and less educated workers, NBER study finds
entry.summary:
Iphepha lokusebenza le-National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER), elibhalwe ngu-Guillermo Cruces, Diego Fernández Meijide, Sebastian Galiani, Ramiro H. Gálvez no-María Lombardi, libika ucwaningo oluhlelwe ngokungahleliwe kubantu abadala abangu-1 174 abenza umsebenzi wokuxazulula izinkinga zamabhizinisi. Ngaphandle kwe-AI ekhiqizayo, ababambiqhaza abane-mfundo ephakeme babenza ngcono kunalabo abanemfundo ephansi ngama-standard deviation angu-0.548; ngosizo lwe-AI, lo mehluko wancipha uya ku-0.139 standard deviation, okuvala cishe izingxenye ezintathu kwezine zomehluko wokuqala. Leli thuba lagcina kuphela ingxenye yalo ngesikhathi ithuluzi le-AI lisuswa emsebenzini olandelayo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Emsebenzini we-Pillar 4 ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana nekhono labathweswe iziqu, ukuqasheka kanye noguquko olunobulungiswa, lokhu okutholakele kunezinhlangothi ezimbili: i-AI ekhiqizayo ingancipha umehluko omdala wokusebenza kahle, kodwa leli thuba liphela uma kungekho umzamo oqhubekayo, ngakho izifundo kusamele zakhe ikhono eliyisisekelo elincike kuphela ku-AI.

National Bureau of Economic Research · Working paper, National Bureau of Economic Research

entry.title: World Bank warns AI's benefits in Africa could bypass the poorest households
entry.summary:
Umbiko we-World Bank, i-Africa Economic Update ka-October 2026, obizwa ngokuthi 'Building AI Readiness', ubikezela ukukhula komnotho e-Afrika esezansi kweSahara kusuka ku-4.1 wamaphesenti ngo-2025 kuya ku-4.3 wamaphesenti ngo-2026, lokhu kuqhutshwa ngokuyingxenye ukukhula okusheshayo kwemisebenzi yabaklami bezinhlelo zokusebenza: isixuku sabaklami bezinhlelo zokusebenza saseNigeria ku-GitHub sikhule kaplishumi kusukela ngo-2020, kanti esaseGhana sikhule phose kasishiyagalombili. Umbiko uphakamisa ukuthi i-AI ingakhulisa umsebenzi omningi futhi idale amathuba omsebenzi kulo lonke lesi sifunda, kodwa uthi ukusetshenziswa kwayo kusalingana ngokungafani futhi kugxile emazweni ambalwa, ikakhulukazi i-Kenya, i-Nigeria ne-South Africa. Ukhomba ugesi othembekile, ukuxhumeka kwe-inthanethi okungabizi, amakhono edijithali kanye namandla kahulumeni njengezimo ezisaswele kwingxenye enkulu yesifunda.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Emsebenzini we-Pillar 6 ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana ne-AI enokuzibophezela, ukulingana kanye nenqubomgomo, umbiko uyisexwayiso esicacile: amasistimu emfundo ephakeme emazweni aseNingizimu Yomhlaba awakwazi ukucabanga ukuthi izinzuzo ze-AI zizofika zizenzekela; ukwakha amandla edijithali nawezikhungo oyisisekelo kusalokhu kuyimfuneko.

World Bank · Intergovernmental regional economic report

entry.title: Critical review finds Ghana's national AI strategy strong on readiness but thin on classroom detail
entry.summary:
Uhlaziyo oluphawulayo lwenqubomgomo, olwenziwe ngu-Matthew Nyaaba kanye nababhali-ndawonye abayisishiyagalolunye, luletha uhlaka lwenqubomgomo ye-AI olugxile kwezemfundo, futhi lusebenzise lona ohlakeni lwe-National Artificial Intelligence Strategy lwaseGhana lweminyaka ka-2025 kuya ku-2035. Ucwaningo luthola ukuthi inqubomgomo iqonde kahle ekufundiseni ngokuhlakanipha kwe-AI, amakhono entsha nokulungela komsebenzi, kodwa ayikathuthuki ngokwanele ekuzimeleni kothisha, ukuqeqeshwa kothisha ngaphambi kokusebenza, iziqondiso zohlelo lwezifundo nokuhlolwa, ukufundisa okusebenzisa izilimi eziningi futhi okuhambisana namasiko, kanye nokulawulwa okubandakanya izakhamizi emazingeni esikole. Ababhali bathi iGhana idinga uhlelo lokusebenzisa olugxile kwezemfundo, oluxhumanisa izinjongo zokulungela komsebenzi nokuqeqeshwa kothisha, ushintsho lohlelo lwezifundo kanye nokuvikelwa kwabafundi.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Emsebenzini we-Pillar 6 ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana ne-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha okulungile, ukulingana kanye nenqubomgomo, lolu hlaziyo luyisikhumbuzo esiwusizo sokuthi izinqubomgomo zikazwelonke ze-AI emazweni aseNingizimu Yomhlaba zivame ukushiya emuva umsebenzi osekilasini odingekayo ukuzenza zibe yiqiniso kothisha nabafundi.

arXiv preprint · Preprint (not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: US study finds no AI-driven unemployment spike yet for recent graduates
entry.summary:
Iphepha elisha lokucwaninga kwezomnotho le-National Bureau of Economic Research, elibhalwe ngu-Robert Fairlie no-Jane Wu, lihlolile idatha yokuqashwa e-United States phakathi kuka-June no-August 2026, ukubheka ukuthi i-AI ekhiqizayo isiqalile yini ukwandisa ukuntuleka komsebenzi kubathweswe iziqu abasanda kuphothula. Beqhathanisa laba nabathweswe iziqu abadala nentsha engafundi eziphakeme, ucwaningo aluveze ukukhuphuka okubalulekile kwezibalo kokuntuleka komsebenzi okuxhumene ne-AI ngehlobo lika-2026, nokuba isilinganiso esibanzi esifaka labo abayekile ukufuna umsebenzi senga amaphesenti angaba ngamabili ezilinganisweni zabathweswe iziqu abasanda kuphothula.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Emsebenzini we-Pillar 4 ka-Wits AHEAD ngekhono labathweswe iziqu, ukuqasheka kanye noguquko olunobulungiswa, lolu ucwaningo luhlolwa ngedatha ukwesaba ukuthi i-AI ekhiqizayo isibhuntshisa amathuba omsebenzi abathweswe iziqu, kukhumbuze ukuhlola imicabango yendawo ngobufakazi hhayi ngezindaba ezivelele.

National Bureau of Economic Research · Economic research working paper

entry.title: Fort Hare study proposes Big Data framework to improve student retention in South Africa
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo olusha oluphume kwi-South African Journal of Information Management, oluvezwa ngu-Ganizani Mainoti no-Roxanne Piderit base-University of Fort Hare, luxoxisane nabasebenzi abafundisayo abangamashumi amathathu emanyuvesi amane omphakathi aseNingizimu Afrika, kanti luphinde lubukeze imibiko kanye nezinqubomgomo zokugcina abafundi. Luthole amasistimu edatha ahlukahlukene nokungabi khona kokuhlakaniphela idatha phakathi kwabasebenzi, kanti luphakamisa uhlaka lwe-Big Data olusekelwe ekuphathweni kwedatha ngokuzibophezela, ukucutshungulwa kwedatha okuhlanganisiwe, ukuhlaziywa kwedatha okubikezelayo kanye nokusekelwa komuntu ngamunye, ukusa amanyuvesi esuka ekusabeleni ekushiyeni kwabafundi isikole kuya ekukuvimbeleni.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Emsebenzini we-Pillar 2 ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana ne-AI kanye nokuhlaziywa kwedatha okubikezelayo kwimpumelelo yabafundi, ukugcinwa kwabo kanye nesexwayiso sangaphambili, luyisibonelo esizalwa ekhaya, esihlolwe ngontanga, sokuthi amasistimu edatha ahlangene kanye nokuphathwa kudingeka kuphi ukuze lolu hlobo lokuhlaziywa lusebenze.

University of Fort Hare, published in the South African Journal of Information Management · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: World Bank's 2026 World Development Report: AI needs reliable power, internet and skills to help developing countries
entry.summary:
Umbiko we-World Bank we-World Development Report 2026, othi 'The Promise of Artificial Intelligence', ubeka isu lokwamukela, ukuzivumelanisa kanye nokuqhubekela phambili kubantu abayizigidi ezingu-5.6 abahlala emazweni angenamali eningi noma aphakathi nendawo. Uphakamisa ukuthi amazwe asathuthuka awadingi ukwakha amamodeli e-AI amakhulu awawo, kodwa ukungenisa amathuluzi e-AI kuphela akuzosiza: i-AI isebenza kahle kakhulu lapho izinsiza zokwakhiwa, kuhlanganise ugesi nokuxhumana, kanye nezinhlelo zemfundo zisebenza kahle kakade, kanti i-'AI encane' elethwa nge-SMS noma ucingo oludala ingafinyelela abantu lapho lezi zinto zincike.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Emsebenzini we-Pillar 6 ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana ne-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha okuhle, ukulingana kanye nenqubomgomo, isixwayiso sombiko sokuthi izinzuzo ze-AI zincike ezinsizeni zokwakhiwa nezinhlelo zemfundo ezisebenza kahle, hhayi nje ukufinyelela kobuchwepheshe, sithinta ngqo izimo amanyuvesi kanye nohulumeni emazweni aseNingizimu Yomhlaba abasadinga ukuzakha.

World Bank · Intergovernmental flagship report

entry.title: UCT video: Cape Town summit brings the global debate on AI and universities to Africa
entry.summary:
Kwividiyo eyakhishwa ngaphambi komhlangano womhlaba wezemfundo ephakeme we-Times Higher Education, iNyuvesi yaseKapa imemezele ukuthi lo mhlangano, obanjwe ngokubambisana neNyuvesi yaseBristol kusukela ngomhla zi-29 kuMandulo kuya kumhla woku-1 kuMfumfu wezi-2026, uzoba owokuqala ukubanjwa kulelizwekazi, uhlanganisa abaphathi bamanyuvesi kanye nabenzi benqubomgomo ukuxoxa nge-AI, ikusasa lomsebenzi, ukungalingani kanye nenjongo yamanyuvesi. Umphathi weNyuvesi, uSolwazi Mosa Moshabela, uthe lo mhlangano uyithuba lamanyuvesi ase-Afrika ukusiza ukubumba uhlelo lomhlaba, okubonisa umbono wakhe wokuthi i-UCT ithuthukise ukufundisa, ucwaningo kanye nomthelela emphakathini kuyilapho iqinisa ukuqamba okusha kanye nobuchwepheshe bamabhizinisi e-Afrika, okususelwe ku-ubuntu.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Emsebenzini wePillar 4 ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana nekhono labathweswe iziqu, ukuqasheka kanye noguquko olunobulungiswa, lokhu kuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi amanyuvesi ase-Afrika manje ayasiza ukumisa, hhayi nje ukulandela, uhlelo lomhlaba mayelana nendlela imfundo ephakeme okufanele isabele ngayo emiphumeleni ye-AI emsebenzini nasethubeni.

University of Cape Town (YouTube) · University video

entry.title: UNESCO working paper maps AI use across 200 Latin American and Caribbean universities

category.term: 19 countries, Latin America and the Caribbean

entry.summary:
Iphepha lomsebenzi elisha le-UNESCO International Institute for Higher Education in Latin America and the Caribbean (IESALC), elenziwe ne-United Nations University Institute for the Advanced Study of Sustainability, lithi kanjani i-AI isetshenziswa emanyuvesini angu-200 emazweni angu-19 aseLatin America kanye naseCaribbean, abuzwa phakathi kweNcwaba kanye noMfumfu wezi-2025. Libheka izici ezinhlanu, ukufundisa nokufunda, ucwaningo, ukubambisana nomphakathi, ukuphatha kanye nokubusa, ukukhombisa lapho i-AI isisetshenziswa khona, indlela elawulwa ngayo, amakhono amanyuvesi akhona kanye nemigoqo esele. Ababhali bafisa ukuthi lokutholakele kusize abaphathi bamanyuvesi kanye nabenzi benqubomgomo yezwe ukuhlanganisa i-AI ngendlela enesibopho, enobuqotho futhi ebandakanya wonke umuntu.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Emsebenzini wePillar 5 ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana nokuhlaziya kanye nedatha ngezinhlelo zemfundo kanye nokuthatha izinqumo, lokhu kunikeza ubufakazi obungavamile obumbozayo kwisifunda sonke sendlela amanyuvesi awabusa ngayo nawaxhasa ngayo ukwamukelwa kwe-AI, kuyiphuzu lokuqhathanisa nenqubomgomo yaseNingizimu Afrika yamanyuvesi.

UNESCO International Institute for Higher Education in Latin America and the Caribbean (IESALC), with UNU-IAS · Intergovernmental working paper

entry.title: MIT's own AI committee calls generative AI 'not an optional exercise' for teaching
entry.summary:
Ikomidi elikhethekile le-MIT elimayelana nokusetshenziswa kwe-AI ekufundiseni, ekufundeni kanye nokuqeqeshwa kocwaningo, elanikwa umsebenzi ngabaphathi beNyuvesi ngoMasingana wezi-2026, likhiphe umbiko walo wokugcina ngomhla zi-25 kuNcwaba wezi-2026, lichaza i-AI ekhiqizayo njengamandla 'anamathuba amangalisayo kanye nobungozi obukhathazayo' angeke aphathwe amanyuvesi njengokuzikhethela kwenqubomgomo. Esikhundleni sokubeka umthetho owodwa, ikomidi lincoma ukuthi ngasinye isikhungo kanye nothisha babeke inqubomgomo yabo ecacile ngesikhathi lapho abafundi kudingeka, bangavumeleka noma akuvunyelwe ukusebenzisa i-AI, baphinde baklame kabusha ukuhlolwa kanye nemigomo yokufunda ngokuhambisana nayo, baphinde baqhubeke nokubuyekeza indlela yabo njengoba ubuchwepheshe bushintsha. Umphathi uSally Kornbluth uthe umbiko lona uyisikhathi esiphambukile, hhayi nje kuphela ku-MIT kodwa nasemfundweni ephakeme ngokuvamile.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Emsebenzini wePillar 1 ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana ne-AI ekhiqizayo emfundweni ephakeme, ukuthi inyuvesi enamandla ocwaningo efinyelela kuso lesi siphetho ngekomidi layo iqinisa isizathu sokuthi uWits nabalingana nawo baphathe inqubomgomo ye-AI ezingeni lezifundo kanye nokuhlolwa okubuyekezwayo njengokuphuthuma, hhayi okuzikhethela.

Massachusetts Institute of Technology · University committee report

entry.title: New dashboard design principles aim to stop learning-analytics tools overstating what they can tell teachers
entry.summary:
Abacwaningi bethule i-TopoLA, ibhodi lokubonisa elisebenzisa indlela yokuhlaziya idatha yetopholoji ebizwa ngokuthi zigzag persistent homology kudatha yamasistimu okuphathwa kokufunda, ukulandelela indlela umsebenzi wokufunda wekilasi oshintsha ngayo ngesikhathi. Ngenxa yokuthi le ndlela yokuhlaziya ayikabi nemithetho eyisisekelo yokutolika, ababhali bamise izinqubo ezintathu zokuklama noma yibhodi elinjalo: ukwahlukanisa ukulinganisa okuluhlaza nokutolikwa kwako, ukuveza imiphumela ngezigaba kunokuyiveza yonke ngasikhathi sinye, kanye nokusho obala ukungaqiniseki kwendlela leyo kunokusho ukunemba okungelona iqiniso.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Emsebenzini wePillar 2 ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana nokuhlaziywa okubikezelayo kanye nokuhlaziywa kokufunda ukuze abafundi baphumelele, lokhu kuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi ibhodi elibukeka linemba akusho ukuthi lithembekile, umehluko obalulekile endleleni amathuluzi yesexwayiso sangaphambili kanye nokugcinwa kwabafundi akhiwa futhi achazwa kubafundisi abancike kuwo.

entry.title: Study finds six AI chatbots give African computing students patchy, often Western-centric career advice

category.term: Ten African countries (study); United States (authors, Florida International University)

entry.summary:
Abacwaningi baseFlorida International University bahlola amamodeli olimi amakhulu ayisithupha, u-ChatGPT-4, u-DeepSeek, u-Gemini, u-Claude 3.5, u-Llama 3 kanye no-Mistral AI, ngendlela abachaza ngayo imisebenzi yokuqala yekhompyutha emazweni ayishumi e-Afrika, ngokuhlaziya izimpendulo ezingu-60 ngokumelene no-Computing Curricula 2020. Ama-chatbot ahlala ehlanganisa amakhono obuchwepheshe afana ne-cloud computing kanye nokuhlela izinhlelo ngendlela efanayo, kodwa aphawula ngomaphesenti ayinga-35.4 kuphela ekuqondeni izici zendawo ezifana nezinhlelo zobuchwepheshe, izilimi, kanye nezinqubomgomo zezwe; amamodeli avulelekile i-Llama (4.47 kweziyisishiyagalombili 5) ne-DeepSeek (4.25) athole amaphuzu angcono kunamamodeli azimele i-ChatGPT-4 (3.90) ne-Claude (3.46), kuyilapho imodeli evulelekile i-Mistral AI ithola u-0.00 kweziyisine (4).

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Emsebenzini wePillar 4 ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana namakhono abathweswe iziqu kanye nokuqasheka, lokhu kubufakazi obuqondile bokuthi iseluleko somsebenzi se-AI, esisesithombe esikhulayo kubafundi base-Afrika, singaphatha imicabango egxile eNtshonalanga mayelana nezingqalasizinda kanye nemakethe yezemisebenzi, okwenza ababhali bathi kudingeka izindlela ezinokuqonda ngokwendawo, ezigxile kubuntu futhi ezisekelwa ngabantu emazweni aseNingizimu Yomhlaba.

arXiv (preprint; submitted to Computers & Education Open) · Preprint (not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: Survey of 443 computing students finds the impostor phenomenon, not confidence, shapes how harshly they judge AI use as cheating
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo olwenziwe kubafundi abangu-443 abafunda izifundo zekhompyutha ezisemazingeni okuqala naphakathi enyuvesi yase-Melika, lwabacela ukuba balinganise ukubucayi kwezigameko eziyi-13 zokukhohlisa kwezemfundo, kuhlanganiswa nokukalwa kokuzethemba kanye nesimo sokuzizwa ungakufanele impumelelo yakho. Abafundi ababe nalesi simo ngamandla amakhulu babevamise ukulinganisa isigameko esihlobene ne-AI njengokukhohlisa okubucayi, kuyilapho ukuzethemba kanye nalesi simo kona kuzihambela ngokuphambene.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Lokhu kuwubufakazi obusizayo emsebenzini wePillar 1 ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana ne-AI ekhiqizayo kanye nobuqotho bezivivinyo: ukuthi umfundi ulahlulela kanjani ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI kungasho ngokuzethemba kwakhe nokuzizwa engowalapha njengokunjalo nesenzo ngokwaso, okubalulekile ekutheni izingxoxo nezinqubomgomo zobuqotho bezemfundo zakhiwe kanjani.

entry.title: Study of 30,000 student programming submissions finds AI-code matches rising over time, but says that alone cannot prove cheating
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo olwahlola imisebenzi engu-29,970 yabafundi emisebenzini yokuzijwayeza yePython yango-2021, u-2023 no-2025, lwayiqhathanisa nezixazululo ezingu-90,000 ezakhiwe yizinhlelo ezintathu ze-AI ezikhulu zolimi, luveza ukuthi ikhodi yabafundi isifana kakhulu ne-AI ekhiqizwe yi-AI ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kuhlanganise nemisebenzi eyiphumelele yonke imivivinyo efihliwe. Emisebenzini emiselwe kabanzi, izinhlelo zagcina zivumelana nemikhiqizo embalwa yekhodi efanayo, kodwa imisebenzi evulekile yahlale ihlukahlukene, kuzo zombili ikhodi yabafundi ne-AI. Ababhali baphetha ngokuthi ukufaniswa okunjalo kuwusizo ekulandeleleni ushintsho kwikilasi lonke, kodwa akufakazeli kukodwa ukuthi umfundi oyedwa wasebenzisa i-AI.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kumsebenzi we-Pillar 1 ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana ne-AI ekhiqizayo, ukuhlolwa kanye nobuqotho basemfundweni, lokhu kuyisixwayiso sokungathembeli ekufaniseni ikhodi njengobufakazi bokona komfundi ngamunye, kanti futhi kukhombisa isidingo sokuhlela kabusha imisebenzi yokuhlola nokwakha uqoqo lwezixazululo zokulinganisa, kunokuncika ekutholeni i-AI kuphela.

entry.title: Wits and UJ researchers show early-warning systems for disengaged students are often tested unfairly
entry.summary:
Abacwaningi be-University of the Witwatersrand ne-University of Johannesburg, kumbhalo ocwaningwayo ongakahlolwa ngontanga, babonisa ukuthi izinhlelo zezexwayiso zangaphambili zokuhlukana kwabafundi nezifundo zivame ukuhlolwa ngolwazi okwakungeke kube khona ngempela ngesikhathi isibikezelo senziwa, okwenza izinhlelo lezi zibukeke zingcono kunokuba ziyoba khona ekusetshenzisweni kwangempela. Ngokuhlola izindlela ezintathu zokubikezela kuzibikezelo ezingu-49 329 zangamasonto onke zesikhathi langempela ezithathwe emilandweni ye-Moodle, bathola ukuthi akukho ndlela eyodwa eyayihamba phambili kuzo zonke izilinganiso, futhi ukwehlisa izinga lokuxwayisa kuthola abafundi abaningi abasengcupheni kodwa kukhuphule izexwayiso ezingamanga okufanele izisebenzi zizilandelele.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Lokhu kubalulekile emsebenzini we-Pillar 2 ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana nokuhlaziywa kwedatha okubikezelayo kwempumelelo yabafundi ngoba kunikeza amanyuvesi aseNingizimu Afrika indlela eqotho kakhulu yokuhlola, ngaphambi kokuthembela kuso, ukuthi ngabe uhlelo lwezexwayiso zangaphambili luzosiza ngempela yini ukubona ngesikhathi abafundi abahlukene nezifundo, hhayi nje ukuthi lubukeka kanjani uma kubukwa emuva.

entry.title: Generative AI access does not mean equal use, study of Chinese, Japanese and Mongolian students finds
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo oluqhathanisa abafundi beziqu ezingaphansi abangu-42, oyedwa enyuvesi eyodwa e-China, eJapan naseMongolia, luthole ukuthi ukuba nokufinyelela ku-AI ekhiqizayo akusho ukuthi kuzosiza ngokulinganayo ekufundeni. Abacwaningi abavela e-University of Osaka, e-University of Minnesota, e-Waseda University nase-Kyoto University babika ukuthi abafundi baseChina babeshintshashintsha phakathi kwezinhlelo ze-AI zasekhaya nezomhlaba wonke, abafundi baseJapan basebenzisa kakhulu amathuluzi omhlaba wonke ngolimi lwesiJapan, kanti abafundi baseMongolia babevame ukushintshela olimini lwesiNgisi uma izimpendulo zolimi lwesiMongolia zibonakala zibuthakathaka; amaqembu womathathu ayehlola nokulandelela ukunemba, ubumfihlo, ukuncika kanye nomthelela emicabangweni yawo ebucayi ngaphambi kokuthemba impendulo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Lokhu kuyisixwayiso emsebenzini we-Pillar 1 ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana ne-AI ekhiqizayo kwimfundo ephakeme: ulimi nezimo zobuchwepheshe bendawo, hhayi nje ukufinyelela, yikho okunquma ukuthi i-AI ekhiqizayo iyabasiza ngempela yini abafundi ukuthi bafunde, isifundo esisebenza ngokuqondile kumasistimu ezinyuvesi ezinezilimi eziningi, angagxilile olimini lwesiNgisi, kulo lonke iNingizimu Yomhlaba.

entry.title: Kyoto University framework offers universities a safer way to share student data with researchers
entry.summary:
Abacwaningi be-Kyoto University baphakamisa i-ReLEAF, uhlaka oluvumela amanyuvesi namaplatifomu okufunda online ukwabelana ngedatha yokufunda abayiqoqayo nabacwaningi abangaphandle, besivikela kangcono ubumfihlo babafundi. Lokhu kunikeza abacwaningi idatha ye-synthetic ephephile yokuqala ukuhlola, bese kuthi emva kwalokho kutholakale ukufinyelela okulawulwayo kudatha yangempela kuphela uma kuvunyelwana nesikhungo esiyiphethe ngesidingo esithile socwaningo. Lolu hlaka lwalungiswa futhi lwahlolwa ngezigaba eziningi zomsebenzi nabaphathi bedatha, abacwaningi kanye nabafundi emanyuvesi aseJapan.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Lokhu kubalulekile emsebenzini we-Pillar 5 ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana nokuhlaziywa kwedatha namasistimu emfundo ngoba amanyuvesi amaningi, kuhlanganise nawaseNingizimu Yomhlaba, anedatha enothile yabafundi kodwa engenayo inqubo ephephile evunyelwene yokwabelana ngayo nabacwaningi; lokhu kunikeza isibonelo esisebenzayo izikhungo ezingasiguqula ngokwazo.

entry.title: UNESCO opens global consultation on governing AI so that education remains a common good
entry.summary:
I-UNESCO ivule inkulumo-mpikiswano yomhlaba wonke, ezoqhubeka kuze kube yiNovemba 2026, imema ososayensi kanye nabenza izinqubomgomo ukuba baphawule kumaphepha asekelayo amayelana nokulawulwa kwe-AI emfundweni. Iphepha eliyinhloko, elikhululwe ngaphambi kweSonto le-Digital Learning Week 2026, licacisa izindlela eziyisithupha izinhloso zemfundo ezingonakaliswa kuzo uma ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI kungalawulwa, futhi liphikisana ngokuthi imfundo kufanele ihlale iyinzuzo evamile, kunokuba ukulawulwa kwayo kushiyelwe abahlinzeki be-AI.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Le nkulumo-mpikiswano izobumba izinqubomgomo ze-UNESCO ezizayo ezihlose imisebenzi kahulumeni nezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, okwenza ibe yindawo ebalulekile yokubhekiswa kwinsika ka-Wits AHEAD yokuthembeka kwe-AI, ukuziphatha, ukulingana nenqubomgomo, ikakhulukazi ezikhungweni zaseNingizimu Yomhlaba ezinamandla amancane okubhala izinqubomgomo zokulawula i-AI zazo.

entry.title: Simple digital markers could flag at-risk first-year computer science students by week five, Southern African study finds

Ababhali bathi imodeli ilula ngokwanele ukuthi isetshenziswe njengesexwayiso sangaphambili kusuka esontweni lesihlanu lenkathi yesikole.

entry.title: Nigerian study finds male pre-service STEM teachers report higher AI literacy than female peers

entry.title: Universities in Korea, Singapore and the United Kingdom take different paths to redesign teaching for AI

I-Korea Times ibika ukuthi amanyuvesi aseKorea engeze izikhala ezingaphezu kuka-4,000 emikhakheni ye-AI nezokukhiqizwa kwezinto zikagesi kusukela ngo-2024, kanti izicelo zokungena emnyangweni we-AI kumanyuvesi angamashumi amabili amakhulu zenyuke ngamaphesenti angu-16 kulo nyaka, kuyilapho uhulumeni kudingeke anqume izikhala ezintsha zobuchwepheshe obuphezulu ku-434 ngo-2027 ngenxa yokuntuleka kwabasebenzi nezinsiza. entry.title: Study proposes voice-based AI interviews as a richer alternative to end-of-semester course surveys
entry.summary:
Ocwaningo abavela e-Technical University of Munich kanye ne-MIT Sloan School of Management baphakamisa ukushintshwa kwemibhalo yokubuyekeza izifundo ekupheleni kwesimesta nokuhlolwa okuhlelekile okwenziwa yi-eyenti ye-AI ekhuluma, engabuza imibuzo elandelayo lapho ifomu elibhalwe lingakwazi. Uhlolo lobuchwepheshe e-Technical University of Munich lwathola ukuthi izinhlolokhono ze-AI ocingweni ziyenzeka, futhi ababhali manje bahlela ucwaningo olugcwele endaweni kwisifundo se-MIT Sloan esinabafundi abacishe babe ngu-60, bahlole impendulo ngokucacile, ngokucebe kwesihloko, ngethoni eyakhayo kanye nokujula kwesimo.

Technical University of Munich and the MIT Sloan School of Management, posted to arXiv · Preprint (not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: Eduvos academic leader tells CNBC Africa that equal access to AI, not only AI literacy, will decide graduate employability
entry.summary:
Engqungqutheleni ye-AI ye-CNBC Africa, umholi wezemfundo ohlomula ngaseEduvos, isikhungo esizimele semfundo ephakeme, uthe amanyuvesi aseNingizimu Afrika angasakwazi ukulinda ukuthi acabange ngokuthi ubuhlakani bokwenziwa (i-AI) busho ukuthini ekufundiseni nakubafundi, futhi ukwazi i-AI, okusho ukwazi ukuthi nini kufanele uncike ku-i-AI futhi nini kufanele ucabange ngokwakho, manje kubalulekile njengokufunda okuyisisekelo. Lo mholi uxwayise ukuthi ukufinyelela ku-i-AI akusho kuphela ukufinyelela eziqu: ngaphandle kokusekelwa kobuxhakaxhaka, ingqalasizinda namadivayisi kubafundi abavela emiphakathini entulayo, i-AI ingakhulisa kunokunciphisa ukungalingani phakathi kwabathweswe iziqu abangena emakethe yezimsebenzi.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngesinsika ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana nekhono labathweswe iziqu, ukuqasheka kanye noguquko olunobulungiswa, lenhlolokhono ikhumbuza ukuthi ukulungela i-AI emfundweni ephakeme yaseNingizimu Afrika kuncike kakhulu ekufinyelelweni okulinganayo kwamathuluzi nengqalasizinda njengoba kuncike nasekufundiseni amakhono e-AI.

CNBC Africa · Broadcast interview, major African business channel

entry.title: Seven-country study finds universities at very different stages of AI readiness
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo olwenziwe emazweni ayisikhombisa yiWISE kanye neInstitute of International Education luthola ukuthi amanyuvesi asezigabeni ezihluke kakhulu zokulungela i-AI ekhiqizayo, kuyilapho inqubomgomo, izimo zengqondo zabafundi kanye nengqalasizinda konke kungalingani. Enyuvesi ezimele yaseGhana, amaphesenti angu-64 othisha abika ukuthi banenqubomgomo ye-AI ecacile, kuyilapho kumanyuvesi kahulumeni ocwaningo kungamaphesenti angu-27, nakuba amaphesenti angu-89 othisha kulolu cwaningo asebenzisa i-AI ngokwabo ngaphambili. Abacwaningi baxwayisa ukuthi, njengoba amamodeli e-AI aholayo afundiswa ikakhulukazi ngesiNgisi nezimiso zolimi ezibusa, izikhungo zase-Afrika namanye amazwe aseNingizimu Yomhlaba zisengozini yokuhlala zisebenzisa i-AI kuphela, hhayi ukuyakha.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngesinsika ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana ne-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha, ubulungiswa kanye nenqubomgomo, lolu cwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi igebe lokulungela phakathi kwezikhungo, hhayi phakathi kwamazwe kuphela, lingakhulisa kunokuncipha ukungalingani endleleni imfundo ephakeme esebenzisa ngayo i-AI.

WISE and the Institute of International Education (IIE), reported by University World News · Established higher education press, reporting a WISE/IIE policy brief

entry.title: Dutch minister calls AI-written theses 'fraud', universities say detection scores cannot prove it
entry.summary:
Ukuhlolwa okwenziwe inethiwekhi yokusakaza yaseNetherlands emaphepheni ocwaningo amaningi abafundi be-master kumanyuvesi ayishumi nambili kuthole ukuthi engxenyeni eyodwa kwezinhlanu, izinhlelo zokuxoxisana njengeChatGPT, iClaude noma iGemini zibhale ingxenye enkulu yombhalo kunomfundi uqobo. UNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo, uRianne Letschert, uthi lokhu kuyinkohliso, kodwa inhlangano emele amanyuvesi aseNetherlands, iUniversiteiten van Nederland, ithi iphuzu lokuhlonza lodwa alikwazi ukufakazela ukona, nokuthi umbuzo ngempela umayelana nendlela amasethingi okuhlolwa enziwa ngayo. AmaNyuvesi aseDelft, aseUtrecht nase Leiden avimbe noma enqabele ukusetshenziswa kwamathuluzi okuhlonza i-AI emisebenzini yabafundi, ethi awethembekile.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngesinsika ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana ne-AI ekhiqizayo emfundweni ephakeme, lo mbango ukhombisa ukuthi ingxabano yobuqotho basezifundweni ingaphenduka kabi ngenhliziyo yezombusazwe uma uNgqongqoshe engenela, futhi kungani leli qembu likhuthaza ukuhleleka kabusha kokuhlolwa esikhundleni sokwethembela kusofthiwe lokuhlonza.

Times Higher Education · Established higher education press

entry.title: Russell Group students say they are taught little about AI, Bett UK survey finds
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo lwe-Bett UK kubafundi beziqu zokuqala abangaphezu kuka-1,000 e-UK luthola ukuthi amaphesenti angu-77 abafundi emanyuvesi e-Russell Group athi afundiswa okuncane noma lutho nge-AI, kuyilapho emanyuvesi angemuva kuka-1992 kungamaphesenti angu-64. Lolu cwaningo lufumene nokuthi amaphesenti angu-78 abafundi angathanda iziqu eziphathelene nobuchwepheshe obuhlanganisa umuntu ngamunye futhi ezithatha isikhathi esincane, kuyilapho amaphesenti angu-34 kuphela azizwa enyuvesi yabo yethembeke kubo mayelana nemiphumela yangempela yabathweswe iziqu. I-Russell Group ithi amalungu ayo asesakha kabusha izifundo kanye nemithetho yokuhlola ngenxa yalokhu.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngesinsika ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana ne-AI ekhiqizayo emfundweni ephakeme, ukutholakala kokuthi amanyuvesi agxile kucwaningo afundisa amakhono e-AI kancane kunemikhungo eyinye kuvusa umbuzo weqiniso wobulungiswa: yibo bani abathweswe iziqu abangena belungiselelwe emsakazweni womsebenzi oguqulwe yi-AI.

Times Higher Education · Established higher education press

entry.title: New framework guides statistics and data science educators on teaching responsible generative AI use
entry.summary:
Ithimba lothisha bezibalo kanye nesayensi yedatha likhiphe uhlaka olunezigaba ezine, ukuqonda, intuthuko, umbiko kanye nokuphepha, ukuqondisa indlela othisha abafundisa abafundi ukusebenzisa amathuluzi e-AI ekhiqizayo ngokuzibophezela kuhlelo lwekhodi nokuhlaziya kwezibalo. Lithuthukiswe ngama-workshop nokuphawula kwabafundi, selisetshenziswe kakade ku-MOOC kanye nokufundisa kwabafundi bokuqala nabaziqu eziphakeme.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Insika 3, i-AI nokuhlaziywa kwedatha kwimfundo ye-STEM nemfundo yothisha, idinga uhlaka olusebenza ekilasini masinyane, hhayi izitatimende zenqubomgomo kuphela; lokhu kunika i-Wits AHEAD isibonelo esisebenzayo sokufundisa ukwazi kahle nge-AI ekhiqizayo ngaphakathi kwesayensi yezibalo.

entry.title: New tool scrambles assignment images so AI reading systems fail, but people can still read them
entry.summary:
Abacwaningi bakhe i-AIRRI, ithuluzi elishintsha izithombe zomsebenzi oshicilelwe ngokuguqula isikhala, ukuzivela nomsindo wezithombe kuhlanganiswe nokuhlasela okuphikisanayo, ukuze amathuluzi oku-OCR namachatbots e-AI akuthole kunzima ukubhala kabusha umbhalo kodwa umuntu olesayo asakwazi ukufunda kahle. Ihlolwe kumasistimu amathathu okufunda, ukuhlasela okunamandla kakhulu kwenza amaphesenti amaphutha wezinhlamvu esistimu enye enyuka kusuka ku-2.3% kuya ku-100%, kanti amaphesenti amaphutha amagama kwesistimu enye enyuka kusuka ku-24.9% kuya ku-96.7%. Ithimba liphinde lakhipha idatha yomsebenzi wemfundo ephakeme ukuhlola indlela.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Insika 1, i-AI ekhiqizayo kwimfundo ephakeme: ukufundisa, ukuhlola, kanye nobuqotho, idinga izivikelo ezisebenza esigabeni somsebenzi uqobo; i-Wits AHEAD ibukele amathuluzi afana nalesi ukubona ukuthi ubuqotho bungakha yini kuzinsiza zekhosi, kunokulandelwa kamuva.

entry.title: New framework argues the cost of AI essay-marking systems should be measured against trustworthy scores, not efficiency alone
entry.summary:
Iphepha elisha liphakamisa uhlaka “Okuklanyiwe Kokulinganisa Okunakekela Izindleko” lwamasistimu wokunikeza amamaki emibhalo ngokuzenzakalela, lithi izindleko zekhompyutha zokulinganisa nge-AI zivame ukuphathwa njengodaba nje lokusebenza kahle kwezobuchwepheshe, kodwa ngempela kuyinqumo yokuklama ukulinganisa. Uhlaka luchaza “izindleko ngamaki angenakuphikiswa” elinganisela amasistimu wokunikeza amamaki kuphela phakathi kokuklanyiwe okufeza izinga eliphansi lokulinganisa okwethembekile, futhi liphatha amandla okuphatha kanye nokugadwa kwesikhungo njengomkhawulo wokuklanyiwe okungasetshenziswa nhlobo, kunokuba izindleko ezidingeka zincishiswe.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwinsika ka-Wits AHEAD ye-AI ekhiqizayo kwimfundo ephakeme, ukufundisa, ukuhlola kanye nobuqotho, uhlaka lunikeza amanyuvesi acabangela ukusebenzisa ukunikeza amamaki ngosizo lwe-AI indlela eqondile yokubuza ukuthi ingabe isistimu eshibhile ikhiqiza ngempela amamaki angenakuphikiswa, kunokuba amathuluzi okuhlolwa okuzenzakalelayo ahlulelwe ngesivinini nezindleko kuphela.

entry.title: Study of a South African university finds online “participation profiles” mostly track how long a learner is observed, not how engaged they are
entry.summary:
Ngokuhlaziya amarekhodi abafundi-amakhono angu-16,448 kubafundi abangu-4,599 kumakhosi angu-152 enyuvesi kahulumeni yaseNingizimu Afrika, abacwaningi bahlola izilinganiso eziyisishiyagalombili ezivame ukusetshenziselwa “ukubamba iqhaza” ku-inthanethi, bathola ukuthi zonke zabonisa ngamandla kakhulu isikhathi umfundi aqashwa ngaso esifundweni kunokubamba iqhaza kwakhe ngempela. Ngemuva kokulungisa lo mphumela, isethi encane yezilinganiso isabahlukanisa abafundi ngephethini ebanzi yezithombe ezimbili kanye nephethini eningiliziwe yezithombe ezine, kodwa ngokuzethemba okulinganiselayo kuphela.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwinsika ka-Wits AHEAD ye-AI kanye nokuhlaziya kwedatha okubikezelayo kwimpumelelo yabafundi, ukutholakala kusiyisexwayiso esiqondile samasistimu wesexwayiso sangaphambili kanye nokugcinwa kwabafundi akhiwe ngedatha yaseNingizimu Afrika: ngaphandle kokuba isikhathi umfundi aqashwa ngaso sibalwa, isithombe esiphawulwe ngokuthi “asihlanganyeli” singaba ngumfundi nje obukelwe isikhathi esincane, kungesi ngempela esisengcupheni.
